📺 The Witcher (2019–Present)

The Witcher follows Geralt of Rivia, a mysterious and highly skilled monster hunter who travels across a dangerous fantasy world known as the Continent, where humans, elves, sorcerers, and terrifying creatures struggle for power and survival. Trained from childhood to become a Witcher, Geralt possesses extraordinary strength, enhanced senses, and powerful fighting abilities that allow him to battle deadly monsters. Despite his reputation as a fearless warrior, he often discovers that humans can be more dangerous than the creatures he hunts. His destiny becomes intertwined with Yennefer of Vengerberg, a powerful sorceress with a complicated past, and Princess Ciri, a young royal whose mysterious abilities make her a target for dangerous forces. As kingdoms wage war, ancient magic resurfaces, and powerful enemies threaten the Continent, Geralt must confront difficult choices while protecting the people he loves. Starring Henry Cavill, Liam Hemsworth, Anya Chalotra, Freya Allan, and Joey Batey, the series delivers breathtaking action, thrilling adventures, supernatural mysteries, and emotional storytelling about destiny, family, sacrifice, loyalty, and the struggle between good and evil.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Action • Adventure • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–65 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Lauren Schmidt Hissrich

📺 Seasons: 4 released • Renewed for a fifth and final season

📚 Based On: The bestselling fantasy book series The Witcher by Polish author Andrzej Sapkowski.

⚔️ Setting: The Continent, a fictional medieval-inspired world filled with monsters, magic, political conflicts, and ancient prophecies.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix (United States)

source_details.synopsis: The Witcher is a fantasy drama television series created by Lauren Schmidt Hissrich for Netflix. It is based on the book series by Polish author Andrzej Sapkowski. Set on a fictional, medieval-inspired landmass known as the Continent, The Witcher explores the legend of Geralt of Rivia, Yennefer of Vengerberg, and Princess Ciri. It stars Henry Cavill and Liam Hemsworth as Geralt, with Anya Chalotra and Freya Allan. The first season, consisting of eight episodes, was released on Netflix on December 20, 2019, starring Cavill in the lead role.
